pages.text: $(bold)Boss spoilers.$() The Pharaoh rises with guards. Clear the immediate area so you can move. Keep a shield and a retreat route, eliminate guards as needed, and move around cover to avoid the boss’s projectiles.
The Pharaoh uses a scepter and god-themed orbs. It summons more guards as its health falls. The Pharaoh is immune to fire, so rely on direct damage and bring healing.

Killing it earns Kingslayer and leaves the slayer Marked for Death. Collect the dropped divine reward and open the unlocked sarcophagus. In a pyramid, the defeat removes block protection, disables traps, and clears spawners.

A matching named ritual uses a single god’s loot pool, with one roll. A plain or mixed ritual draws from the gods at random. More pieces of a set require more encounters. See $(l:atum:divine/artifact_hunting)Hunting Artifacts$(/l).
